# Story locations

Original generated painted environments, optimized to 1536×1024 WebP. These are artistic impressions, not verified layouts or photographs of Vivenza.

| Asset                 | Story action                                            |
| --------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------- |
| courtyard.webp        | Friends meet at home and exchange the invitation        |
| pickup.webp           | Their car collects them outside the home                |
| drive-navratri.webp            | A lantern-lit road with Navratri celebrants along the sides, viewed through the windscreen  |
| selfie-corner.webp    | Floral photo alcove inside the venue                    |
| shrine-courtyard.webp | Aarti in a devotional courtyard before the Garba circle |

The same teal evening sky, amber lantern light, carved Gujarati architecture and marigold decoration connect the locations. Each leaves clear foreground space for the original characters. Mobile uses the central composition; the driving zoom is anchored at the road vanishing point. Keep each image mapped to its story action when replacing artwork.
